article.title: Will the Argentina province of La Rioja print its own currency?
article.excerpt: Maybe so: Milei’s austerity is biting hard in La Rioja, an olive and wine region home to 384,000 people — out of a population of 46mn — where intense heat pushes many businesses to take a siesta from 1 to 6pm.
